title: Colorado Front Range viewed from Broomfield

elevation.author: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program
elevation.product: 1 arc-second Digital Elevation Model, NAD83, elevations in metres

surface.author: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
surface.changes: Resampled orthophotography, shaded with DEM slope and aspect, and illustrated high-elevation November snow cover.

alpineModel.title: Snowy Mountain
alpineModel.author: James Lucas
alpineModel.changes: Reconstructed the height field from eight mesh sections and registered its snow and rock artwork to the UVs. Rotated, rescaled and blended the relief and surface colors onto selected high-elevation Colorado summits.

registration.projection: EPSG:3857, locally scaled by cosine of origin latitude; east is +X and south is +Z
registration.notes: USGS elevations anchor the summits, with up to 145 m of illustrative relief on their upper flanks. Distant-relief rendering applies curvature and a gradual 1.12× to 1.82× vertical emphasis for legibility at the game's wide field of view. Snow extent is seasonal artwork.
